# lazy-component

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Pairs React.lazy with its own Suspense boundary so a heavy component is code-split off the eager plugin-boot wave, loading on first mount instead. HoldLazyMount: under it, a lazy component mounting by a deferred render (a pane navigation) suspends that render instead of drawing its fallback, so the previous screen stays until its chunk is in.
- Web:
  - Uses:
    - `primitives/css/center.Center`
    - `primitives/loading.Loading`
  - Exports (types): `LazyComponentOptions`
  - Exports (values):
    - `HoldLazyMount`
    - `lazyComponent`
    - `useLazyReady`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `apps/sonata/notation`
    - `apps/sonata/piano-roll`
    - `apps/sonata/piano-roll/fx-comets`
    - `apps/sonata/piano-roll/fx-core`
    - `apps/sonata/piano-roll/fx-ripples`
    - `apps/sonata/piano-roll/fx-shatter`
    - `apps/website/shell`
    - `map/google`
    - `page/math/render`
    - `primitives/graph-canvas`
    - `primitives/markdown`
    - `primitives/pane`
    - `primitives/syntax-highlight/code-preview/mermaid`
    - `primitives/text-editor`
- Test helpers:
  - Web: `@plugins/primitives/plugins/lazy-component/web/testing`
    - `loadLazyComponents` — Load every lazy component's chunk declared so far — call it in a suite's `beforeAll`, after the imports that declare them.
